name: sidecar_wal_without_shm
description: The workspace includes a stray WAL sidecar without a matching SHM sidecar or coordinated writer state.
source_hint: Represents the stale or missing sidecar family called out in beads_rust-rsei.2.1.
notes: The database file itself is healthy so the fixture isolates how database-family authority reacts to sidecar corruption.
The synthetic WAL has invalid magic, making the family uninspectable; ordinary and doctor mutations fail closed until an operator restores an inspectable family.
